notes.title: [1.0.2f] Certain types of corrupt savefiles will now load
notes.notes:
This is a quick follow-up to my previous patch: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2013730/view/810198487112095150

In that patch, I solved an issue that arose when a gourdlet who was on a building’s guest list was deleted, but anyone who ran into that issue prior to my fix would have ended up with a corrupted savefile.

In this patch, I wrote an update that fixes those corrupted savefiles. With this patch, no action is needed by the user, and the previously corrupted savefile should just work!

notes.title: [1.0.2e] Ability to delete gourdlets: fixed an edge case bug
notes.notes:
Issues fixed:
[url=https://trello.com/c/ssBJyQGS/107-ghost-gourdlet-named-null]Ghost gourdlet named "Null"[/url]

In my previous patch, I added the ability to delete gourdlets. I did not realize that an issue would arise when you try to delete a gourdlet that is already included in a building's guest list. This patch fixes the issue.

If anyone ran into this issue and got to a corrupt savefile, please feel free to reach out to me directly on discord and I will try to salvage your savefile!

notes.title: [1.0.1c] Fix crashes on initial load
notes.notes:
This should fix the issue that a small percent of users were experiencing, where the initial loading screen would fill up partway and then the game would crash. It seemed to mostly impact users with AMD graphics, and or people with older model macbooks. 

The cause of the issue was that the asset textures took up too much memory, which caused the VRAM to spike past the capacity of certain computers. This patch reduces the size of the asset textures, and has a couple other small optimizations to slightly reduce lag. 

The changes should not noticeably impact gameplay for anyone who was previously able to play the game without any problems.

notes.title: [1.0.0f] More clear labelling for mouse mode vs controller mode
notes.notes:
tl;dr: Added small changes to make it more clear when a controller was detected.

Some people are inadvertently playing in controller mode with their mouse an keyboard (which is a pretty terrible ui experience) because it isn't clear in the game when a controller is autodetected. This patch adds a small label to the town creator screen saying whether the game is in mouse or controller mode, and a button that jumps straight to the settings page to change modes.

Also stopped setting the mouse cursor to invisible whenever a controller is detected- it’s just too annoying when the player doesn’t realize they have a controller plugged in and want to use their mouse!

Note that I am still spending 90% of my time working on the issue where the game crashes on startup for some players. I just saw a lot of reports regarding this issue and decided to implement this change because it was a quick fix!

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!!!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

I am super excited to be writing to you all today, as I have BIG NEWS…

Gourdlets can be yours on August 15th!! 🎉

It's so cool to be able to finally say that! Over the last couple months I’ve made some really exciting additions to the game, like a new ‘town ledger’ feature which includes names and photos of all your gourdy residents, you can now watch the world you’ve created change with the seasons, and fill your island with tons of items and activities to keep your gourdlets happy (including a Ferris Wheel whaaat?!)💜

[previewyoutube=_z7VXzfbifU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Thank you!![/b]

I want to say a big big thank you to everyone who has played the demo, sent feedback and expressed their interest in my first ever game, it’s all contributed so much to the process, which I hope you’ll be able to see when you play. I’m so excited to finally bring the full game to you all! If you’re new here, welcome 💜 Hope you like adorable little vegetable folks…!

Thanks for reading and see you on the 15th!

- Preethi Vaidyanathan

notes.title: April Development update!
notes.notes:
Hello Gourdlet friends!

Now that it’s starting to get warm enough to venture outside, I thought this would be a good time to take tentative steps out of my solo development cave and give a little update on what I’ve been working on, which recently, has been tons and tons of drawing. 

If you happened to catch me at GDC & Day of the Devs then maybe you got a sneak peek at some of the new things I’m working on! Thank you everyone who took the time to say hello! 

I can’t wait to share more news soon but until then… I thought it would be fun to dig up some old pictures and show you how the drawings have evolved. 

[h2]Behind the Scenes: Home Sweet Home![/h2]

Here is the original house artwork that I drew in June 2022, when Gourdlets didn’t have a name yet and was just a hobby that I would spend a few hours on each weekend. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/fb055b4024aeea9f2cf218dffe3e54efa343d8e1.png[/img]

And then here it was in November 2022, a week before I put up the Steam page and Gourdlets became slightly more real. I realized that not all pixel art needs a thick dark border! With enough visual trickery in the game, this makes things look slightly more 3D. It’s a big compliment when someone is surprised to hear that all of the art in the game is just flat PNG images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/67a0c8b722b5bd675956b21d0a6415901fd048e2.png[/img]

And then here is what I came up with this past February, at which point I had been seriously working on Gourdlets for a full year, and was fully in the grips of insanity- dreaming in lines of code, losing all objectivity, and spending 2 hours moving around the pixels on an individual roof shingle in a way that no one but me could possibly notice. But in a fun way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/fa335755cbc3b247c6d0d959519a0bef7f65af6f.png[/img]

I’ve also been hard at work on programmatically generating many colors of each object- this is really fun because I just have to draw the 1 base item, and then can spend the next 15 hours a normal amount of time coming up with a color palette, and then my code spits out all the recolored artwork. I’m also working on updating the UI like crazy to make it look more organized, here’s a sneak peek at what I have so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/ec277b45a0a695f0418647186bb0899fd5972058.jpg[/img]

Plus a sneak peek at some of the other buildings! There are just a few houses in the current Steam demo, but now I have 8 base houses x 8 colors = 64 unique house buildings. Math!

And here they are on display with a few other new items… 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/15e061c42302c7957410b96496f95d14d271dce5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cool houses! Now what?[/h2]

Now it’s time for me to get back to drawing a ton more objects, and answering tricky questions like: do gourdlets need toasters??????

Thank you so much for reading this and supporting the development of Gourdlets! Here is your reward: an important picture of Cinny and Poppy eating salad.

notes.title: Gourdlets at the 2023 Wholesome Direct!
notes.notes:
Dear Gourdlets fans, 

Did you see my cozy city builder at the 2023 Wholesome Direct? :) If not, then feel free to watch the new 30-second trailer below. It has a surprise toward the end that I think many of you will be happy about. 

[previewyoutube=hq3X9F-vPB8;full][/previewyoutube]
That’s right – I’ve added farming to Gourdlets! As a fan of the coziness of the farming sim genre, I’m particularly excited about this one.

Draw in tilled soil, plant seeds, and the Gourdlets will water them and pull weeds to grow a beautiful garden. Much like your building journey in Gourdlets, a small seed will grow into a lovely plant that the Gourdlets can be proud of having harvested! Every plant has 3 stages: seeds, seedling, and mature plants. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/0628a339a43b9ecb357027175fa345e60fffa077.gif[/img]

The Gourdlets will then pick ripe plants, but I’m still working on what they should do with the plants – either pluck them and eat them right there or maybe something more interesting. In the meantime, I’ve also added a new barn building. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/c2e8b96046194431a0c4b1171365536f22d141f2.gif[/img]

As you can tell, I really value the feedback my little game has gotten so far. Every day, it’s becoming a game I’m even more eager to keep developing. If you want a more direct say in what features I might add next, join the Gourdlets Discord server. You can find it here: http://discord.gg/xYgv78Azwe.

Thank you for your continued support for Gourdlets – have fun continuing to play the demo and see you next time.

-Preethi

notes.title: Demo updates! (Paint bucket tool, prettier fences, quality of life updates)
notes.notes:
Dear Gourdlets fans,
I am excited to announce some new updates for my cozy city builder game that I hope will make the demo more fun :)
I have added *the most requested feature* - a paint bucket tool! Without it, building big islands took a LOT of clicking, hopefully this makes things a little easier. You can now quickly and easily fill in large areas with the click of a button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/f5533bdcb735c94d09c16dca7b1572fec278e202.png[/img]

In addition, I have made changes to the fences to make them more intuitive, making it easier to form corners and create enclosures. This is perfect for those who want to build their own little zoos! (Little animals for the zoos are forthcoming 👀)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/36abc17a4dc790beb4ca21cfd821d02b5bcd78f4.png[/img]

I also heard your feedback regarding the monorail and have added a stoplight that can turn it on and off. Some players felt that the monorail was arriving too frequently before the island was ready for visitors, so I hope that this will help address that issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/ef228f37e3cd12d3e1e4db75adae416df7fd2a26.png[/img]

Finally, I have made some UI and quality of life updates, including a window explaining the controls and some handy shortcuts.
If you try out the updated demo, I’d love to hear your thoughts! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to me, so please don't forget to fill out the feedback form here: https://forms.gle/aRtnxERfZEQJrynM7
Or, if you want a more direct voice in development, come join the discord! http://discord.gg/xYgv78Azwe
Thank you for your continued support of Gourdlets, and I hope that you enjoy these updates!
- Preethi (Aunty Games)

notes.title: 🏡 Demo Update: Interior decorating
notes.notes:
Hello Gourdlets fans!

I'm Preethi Vaidyanathan, developer of Gourdlets. Welcome to my first steam update :)

Big news! I have just added a brand new feature to Gourdlets, the cozy city builder - interior decorating! Now, you can enter buildings and decorate them to your heart's content. This new feature adds a whole new level of personalization to the game and allows you to create unique spaces that truly feel like your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/73ea7a98b58af3a8e3cb6442289592af39a5a4df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/587d24777fb24d8cc231ac0c0e1811ab3467d651.png[/img]

To give you a taste of what's possible with this new feature, I have added items that let you create a cozy cafe to the demo. Now, your gourdlets can browse dessert stands, play chess, and drink tea while surrounded by delightful decor. But that's just the beginning! I am planning to add even more items for houses, libraries, shops, and more. With each new addition, you'll have even more options for customizing your spaces and making them uniquely yours.

I am thrilled to see how players will use this new feature to express their creativity and make the game world their own. I can't wait to hear your feedback as you explore all the possibilities of interior decorating in the coziest city builder.

Don't forget to [url=http://s.team/a/2013730]wishlist[/url], and [url=discord.gg/xYgv78Azwe]join the Discord[/url], where you can suggest new items and interactions for me to add to the game. I love hearing from our players and value your input as I continue to develop Gourdlets. Thank you for playing, and happy decorating!

-Preethi
